rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and ZIP, matched to a single user, and only acted on that user’s account. They inspected the user’s orders via tools, identified both tablets and their prices, and confirmed which one to return. Before making any changes, the agent sought explicit confirmation. Although the agent initially stated the refund would go to the credit card, they did not proceed; when the user questioned this, the agent correctly clarified that the refund must go to the original payment method for that order (the gift card) and obtained explicit approval to proceed. The return was then executed using the correct order and item IDs, with the refund routed to the correct gift card per the tools, and the agent provided accurate final details (amount, method, and next steps). No writes were performed without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and final information was correct. Minor early misstatement was corrected prior to any action, so overall the outcome meets the pass criteria.
